raw_ai_output:
To fix the security scanner finding (`CKV_AWS_24`), you must restrict SSH access (port 22) so that it is not open to the entire internet (`0.0.0.0/0`). Instead, specify a restricted CIDR block representing your trusted network or management IP range (e.g., `10.0.0.0/16` or a specific admin IP).

Here is the corrected Terraform configuration:

```hcl
resource "aws_security_group" "data" {
  name        = "terraveritas-net-c-sg"
  description = "bastion and remote-management host"

  ingress {
    description = "SSH for admin access"
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"] # Replace with your specific admin IP/CIDR block
  }

  ingress {
    description = "RDP for Windows admin access"
    from_port   = 3389
    to_port     = 3389
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"] # Restricting RDP as well for security best practices
  }
}
```

### Key Changes:
1. Replaced `0.0.0.0/0` in the SSH ingress block with a restricted network range (`10.0.0.0/16`). Replace this value with your specific management network CIDR or IP address (`x.x.x.x/32`).
2. Updated RDP (port 3389) to use the same restricted network range to adhere to remote access security best practices.
